title: Behavior Trees in Autonomous Systems and Robotics
description: A living, graph-explorable knowledge base for behavior trees in robotics and autonomous systems.

taxonomy.title: Behavior Trees
taxonomy.description: Executable hierarchical structures for behavior selection, sequencing, and switching in autonomous agents.

taxonomy.title: Foundations
taxonomy.description: Core behavior-tree definitions, formal models, terminology, and architectural principles.

taxonomy.title: Execution Semantics
taxonomy.description: Tick-based evaluation and the Success, Failure, and Running status semantics used during BT execution.

taxonomy.title: Control Flow
taxonomy.description: Composition operators such as Sequence and Fallback/Selector that determine how child behaviors execute.

taxonomy.title: Reactivity
taxonomy.description: Repeated condition evaluation, feedback, and preemption that let BTs adapt execution as state changes.

taxonomy.title: Modularity and Composition
taxonomy.description: How behavior subtrees encapsulate functionality and compose into larger reusable control structures.

taxonomy.title: Robot Control
taxonomy.description: Use of behavior trees as high-level executives and switching structures in robotic control systems.

taxonomy.title: Comparisons with Other Architectures
taxonomy.description: Conceptual and formal comparisons between BTs and alternative decision, planning, and control architectures.

taxonomy.title: Decision Trees
taxonomy.description: Predictive tree models that route feature tests to classification or regression outputs rather than executing behaviors.

taxonomy.title: Finite-State Machines
taxonomy.description: State-and-transition control structures used as a common comparison point for behavior-tree modularity and switching.

taxonomy.title: Planning and Task Decomposition
taxonomy.description: Plan generation and hierarchical task decomposition methods that can complement or synthesize behavior-tree execution structures.

taxonomy.title: Surveys and Reviews
taxonomy.description: Literature surveys and review articles that map behavior-tree research, applications, methods, and open problems.

taxonomy.title: Machine Learning
taxonomy.description: Learning methods relevant to decision-tree induction and to learned or synthesized behavior-tree systems.

sections.title: Topics
sections.description: Cross-cutting concepts and synthesis across the literature.

documents.title: Topics overview
documents.description: Index of current topic syntheses and the conceptual areas planned for expansion in the knowledge base.

documents.title: Behavior tree foundations: what BTs are and how they differ from decision trees
documents.description: Defines behavior trees as executable task-switching structures and contrasts their semantics with predictive decision trees, FSMs, and planners.

sections.title: Papers
sections.description: Notes on individual papers and technical publications.

documents.title: Papers overview
documents.description: Index of the current paper notes and the standard fields used to summarize technical publications in this repository.

documents.title: Marzinotto et al. (2014) — Unified BT framework for robot control
documents.description: A foundational robotics formulation that gives behavior trees a unified execution semantics for robot control.

documents.title: Colledanchise & Ögren (2017) — BT modularity and generalization
documents.description: Formalizes BT modularity for hybrid control and relates behavior trees to sequential compositions, subsumption, FSM-like switching, and decision trees.

documents.title: Iovino et al. (2022) — Survey of Behavior Trees in robotics and AI
documents.description: A broad survey of behavior-tree research across robotics and AI, including design, synthesis, learning, and application trends.

documents.title: Ögren & Sprague (2022) — Behavior Trees in robot control systems
documents.description: A control-systems review emphasizing feedback, modularity, and the role of behavior trees in robot control architectures.
documents.venue: Annual Review of Control, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems

documents.title: Quinlan (1986) — Induction of Decision Trees
documents.description: A canonical machine-learning paper on inducing classification decision trees, included as a comparison point for behavior-tree semantics.

documents.title: Notes overview
documents.description: Index of working notes, cross-paper synthesis, research directions, and knowledge-base infrastructure documentation.

documents.title: Knowledge Graph Explorer
documents.description: Documents the graph schema, entity relationships, filters, layouts, inspector metadata, and scaling conventions for the GitHub Pages explorer.

documents.title: References
documents.description: Consolidated bibliography covering the behavior-tree foundations, surveys, control literature, and decision-tree comparison sources used by the knowledge base.
